_note: SERP snapshot for the information-gain gate. The research pass for this topic found that English coverage of China's 2026 tariff adjustment plan reported the import side (935 provisional import rates, 8,972 tariff lines, zero tariffs for 43 least-developed countries) and did not open Annex 3, the export goods tariff schedule. The results below are the top English-language coverage of that plan; mof.gov.cn and chinatax.gov.cn are official publishers and are excluded automatically.
